hero.heading: A cloud you own should be as easy as one you rent.
hero.lead: Crustates is an independent open source project. Our mission: make running your own compute, storage and network at home safe, simple and fully yours, with no subscription and no lock-in.

story.heading: Why we're building it
story.lead: A typical homelab is a hypervisor, a NAS, a container panel, a reverse proxy and a VPN, each with its own login, its own update button and its own idea of what a disk is. It works until it doesn't, and then you're debugging five products at once.
paragraphs: Crustates started as one person's attempt to replace that stack with one platform: one read-only OS, one API, one console. It's written in Rust where we write code, and leans on proven open source (QEMU, Cloud Hypervisor, containerd, ZFS, Caddy, WireGuard) everywhere else.
The name? Crustaceans grow by moulting their shell. So does Crustates: the whole OS is replaced by a new image on every upgrade.

items.title: Yours, all of it
items.body: No account to sign in, no cloud dependency, no telemetry unless you switch it on.

items.title: Secure by default
items.body: Read-only OS, a kernel per app, passkeys, signed images. Nothing to harden afterwards.

items.title: API first
items.body: Everything the console does, the API does. Scripts, OpenTofu and agents are first-class.

items.title: Reuse, don't reinvent
items.body: Proven engines behind clean Rust interfaces, swappable when something better arrives.

items.title: Boring upgrades
items.body: Atomic, signed, with one-step rollback. Upgrading should never be the scary part.

items.title: Open by licence
items.body: AGPLv3, so improvements to the platform stay open for everyone.

items.maintainers: Maintainers review and merge; GOVERNANCE.md says who they are.
items.adr: ADRs: every significant decision is an architecture decision record in the repo, open for comment before it's accepted.
items.dco: DCO: contributors sign off their commits; no CLA, so nobody can relicense your work.
items.roadmap: Roadmap in the open, milestone by milestone.

licence.heading: AGPLv3 platform, Apache-2.0 SDKs
paragraphs: The platform (OS image, control plane, agent, console) is AGPLv3: use it for anything, and if you offer a modified version as a service, share your changes.
SDKs, the plugin interfaces and the OpenTofu provider are Apache-2.0, so you can build closed or open plugins and tooling on top.

sustainability.heading: Independent, with no paid edition
sustainability.lead: No venture capital. How sponsorship and optional paid support will work is still being decided; every feature stays in the open source release.

contact.heading: Built in NL, for homelabs everywhere.
